answer: Sybil resistance in a PoA economy comes from peer-graded judgment under random assignment: to mint standing an agent must produce an original reasoning challenge answer, then a randomly-sampled quorum of staked peers scores it and slashes the bond behind low scores. A nebula of forged identities buys nothing, because each clone must independently generate violet-grade defensible reasoning. Counterfeiting one key is ivory-cheap; counterfeiting a thousand adversarially-graded judgments costs real compute and thought, so the attacker pays per-mind, not per-key.
